title: etzhayyim docs registry (docs.json)
description: Schema for 90-docs/_registry/docs.json — the machine-readable sidecar index regenerated from .md front-matter by 70-tools/scripts/docs/regen-registry.py. Canonical source is the Markdown bodies; this schema describes the normalized JSON shape that downstream consumers + validate-adrs.py drift-check rely on. Refreshed cycle 50 (2026-05-27) to match real data: snake_case field names, 90-docs/ path prefix, 10 doc_type values, governance-evolving status values.

status.description: Governance-evolving status field. Common values include: active / proposed / accepted / deprecated / superseded. ADR-specific values may appear (e.g. proposed-pending-council-ratification, implemented, draft, deferred). Schema is permissive on this field while data normalization is governance-bounded; future schema tightening requires Council Lv6+ ≥3.

depends_on.description: ADR depends_on chain — list of doc-id references. Cycle 64 surfaced this previously-unindexed frontmatter field.

last_verified.description: ISO 8601 date or datetime. Accepts YYYY-MM-DD or full ISO 8601 with optional time + Z timezone. Free-form annotations after the date (e.g. 'YYYY-MM-DD (notes)') are flagged as errors — keep notes elsewhere in the front-matter.
